world_scale_backbone.purpose: Guarantees that the origin-connected world component has routes extending infinitely in all cardinal directions while ordinary side branches may dead-end.

liminal_macro_regions.info_unlock: Entering a V15 district automatically finds its Infinite World archive page; no physical note is generated.
liminal_macro_regions.legacy_behavior: V9-V14 keep their old deterministic anomaly probabilities/types and physical field-note behavior.

multi_level_infinite_network.secondary_horizontal_routes: one deterministic infinite east-west route per 18-chunk row band, excluding primary rows
multi_level_infinite_network.secondary_vertical_routes: one deterministic infinite north-south route per 18-chunk column band, excluding primary columns

merchant_system.note: V13 keeps merchants off anomaly/primary/secondary route chunks, but increases lattice density and makes loaded outposts visible on the map. When an unannounced outpost is within 2 chunks, a localized message tells the player a merchant is nearby.
merchant_system.access_rule: Shop entrance must have a passable route to at least one shared chunk-edge gateway after all themed rooms and infinite-road passes are complete.
merchant_system.v15_site_locking: Merchant/no-merchant status is frozen in objectStates when a chunk is first generated so later progression never rewrites old terrain.
merchant_system.stock_tier_lock: Each merchant locks its stock tier when the Hero first comes within 2 chunks.
merchant_system.bag_rule: Until all four are owned, every newly encountered merchant dedicates slot 0 to one currently missing bag.
merchant_system.equipment_rule: Tier 0 restricts equipment to basic weapon/armor; wands/rings and +1 equipment become increasingly available later.

guaranteed_artifact_chest.spawn_distance_cells: Hero-centered 3x3 neighbourhood: one of the 8 adjacent cells; if none is valid, retry on the next positive Hero action
guaranteed_artifact_chest.contents: one artifact selected from the remaining Generator artifact deck when possible
guaranteed_artifact_chest.lifecycle_states: 0 not spawned / 1 closed / 2 opened heap / 3 artifact taken

dynamic_accent_overlay_refresh.purpose: Prevent static mixed-theme wall/floor overlays from visually covering terrain that has become passable after explosions or secret-door discovery.

dynamic_monster_progression.scope: Infinite World ordinary ecology + level-30 breakthrough trial
dynamic_monster_progression.snapshot_rule: monster scaling is locked when the mob spawns; changing Hero equipment does not mutate already-active mobs
dynamic_monster_progression.dynamic_threat_level: 1-60; approximately 78% Hero level + 22% weighted gear score + small artifact ownership bonus
dynamic_monster_progression.hp_scaling: responds primarily to offensive upgrades; roughly 0.95 + 0.025*(heroLevel-1) + 0.16*offensivePower, capped before trial-wave multiplier
dynamic_monster_progression.damage_scaling: responds primarily to defensive upgrades; roughly 0.95 + 0.018*(heroLevel-1) + 0.12*defensivePower, capped before trial-wave multiplier
dynamic_monster_progression.accuracy_and_defense: moderate progression with Hero level + weighted gear
dynamic_monster_progression.loot_probability: base loot chance multiplied by dynamic reward scale, capped at 2.25x before existing wealth/talent interactions are bounded to 100%
dynamic_monster_progression.xp_floor: 4 + dynamicThreatLevel/3, while preserving higher native EXP

breakthrough_progression.token: BreakthroughToken is automatically issued at level 30 until the trial succeeds
breakthrough_progression.wave_scaling: wave 1 is intentionally softer; enemy pools and multipliers rise each wave; wave 10 mixes five late-game threats with five mid-game threats
breakthrough_progression.failure: non-lethal; pre-trial Hero/inventory/gold/energy snapshot is restored and a new token is issued
breakthrough_progression.success: returns to the prior Infinite World position and unlocks level 60 / +120 equipment / +30 artifact progression
breakthrough_progression.aid: arena contains scattered healing, food and utility scroll/potion supplies

infinite_world_intro.theme: one persistent boundless stitched world of ordinary, ruined and Backrooms-inspired regions whose danger adapts to the Hero

v9_balance.room_rewards: reduced to preserve long-term exploration value
v9_balance.secret_room_discovery: one deterministic forced secret-room candidate per 3x3 chunk macro plus random secret rooms; close-range passive search boosted in Infinite World

v12_discovery_balance.anomaly_note_rule: When entering an anomaly whose field-note page has not been collected, a visible InfiniteWorldNote is guaranteed near the hero; legacy anchor notes remain as deterministic world content.
v12_discovery_balance.artifact_chest_rule: At 400 positive hero action-value, exactly one guaranteed crystal artifact chest is created near the hero and persisted by world coordinates/state.

v13_discovery_balance.note_rule: All six anomaly types use the existing near-hero unread-note guarantee plus deterministic anchor notes.

assist_item_grant.category_flow: equipment-or-consumables -> Catalog category -> exact item -> quantity
assist_item_grant.keys: added to Notes/key records at current depth

special_items.dewdrop: adds dew to Waterskin up to capacity; requires Waterskin

infinite_spectator_test_mode.monster_actor_freeze: All Mob actors are frozen at Actor.process scheduler boundary while active.
infinite_spectator_test_mode.manual_interactions_preserved: chests, pickups, merchant trade, keys/doors and normal Hero interactions continue to use normal actions
infinite_spectator_test_mode.exploration: normal Dungeon.observe/FOV/visited flow continues each step and InfiniteWorldState exploration is synchronized
infinite_spectator_test_mode.hero_render_layer: temporarily rendered above raised terrain/walls so the hero remains visible while inside walls
infinite_spectator_test_mode.exit_safety: if disabled while inside invalid terrain, Hero is moved to nearest normal standable cell
infinite_spectator_test_mode.visual_move_multiplier_rule: The sprite tween also uses at least x8 in spectator mode so animation keeps pace with Hero.speed().
infinite_spectator_test_mode.movement_animation: Idle pose glides between cells with native CharSprite.State.LEVITATING effect; normal run animation is suppressed.
infinite_spectator_test_mode.test_view_radius_rule: Only Infinite World spectator mode forces ShadowCaster.MAX_DISTANCE; normal gameplay view distance is unchanged.

v15_backrooms_archive.visual_strategy: Built-in sewers/prison/caves/city/halls textures are recombined with distinct deterministic terrain layouts; no external wiki imagery is copied.

v15_merchant_progression.base_density: 3-chunk deterministic lattice plus additional sparse lattices unlocked for newly generated chunks at progress tiers 1-4.
v15_merchant_progression.terrain_stability: Each chunk's merchant-site result is persisted on first generation.

v15_environment_props.source_license: Kenney Tiny Town 1.1 + Tiny Dungeon 1.0, CC0 1.0
v15_environment_props.placement: Deterministic sparse overlays after normal heaps/traps/plants/merchant stock are created; V15 anomaly chunks receive two props and ordinary chunks receive one with ~62% chance.
v15_environment_props.examine_support: WndInfoCell sees the CustomTilemap image and localized name/description, so magnifier inspection identifies each prop.
v15_environment_props.terrain_safety: Props never mutate map[]/passability/water/doors and are excluded from occupied heaps/traps/plants/chars and common center crossing lanes.

physicality.generator_v15_old_worlds: expanded visual props only; bulky scenery remains pass-through for compatibility
physicality.generator_v16_new_worlds: bulky scenery uses Terrain.CUSTOM_DECO solid cells; mushrooms/ferns/torches/rubble remain pass-through
physicality.generator_v17_new_worlds: all 30 visible scenery kinds use Terrain.CUSTOM_DECO solid cells; none are pass-through

hard_prop_safety: all V17 props are real blockers; there are no pass-through decoration fallbacks
local connectivity test rejects blocker placement on chokepoints and accounts for already selected blockers

v17_solid_scenery_and_artifact_pacing.legacy_v16_rule: V16 saves retain the old pass-through exceptions for mushrooms, ferns, decorative torches and rubble.
v17_solid_scenery_and_artifact_pacing.artifact_spawn_area: Hero-centered 3x3 cell neighbourhood, excluding Hero cell
v17_solid_scenery_and_artifact_pacing.artifact_key: one CrystalKey is added when the guaranteed chest appears

v17_long_run_progression.artifact_post_cap_growth: after the native +10-equivalent cap, the equipped artifact earns one extra visible level per roughly 1.5 Hero levels of XP until +30; Assist boost can also test the cap
v17_long_run_progression.cheat_test_button: Infinite World Assist menu includes one-click Hero +1 level testing and respects the level-30 gate

hard_invariants: Always increment versionCode for installable builds.
Do not stream/rebuild the Infinite World window before Hero movement tween completion.
Do not remove streaming hysteresis without redesigning and stress-testing it.
Do not permanently hide the normal animated water backdrop.
Tilemap synchronous streaming refresh must actually upload dirty VBO data to GL.
Do not treat generated chunks as explored chunks.
All cross-position Hero movement must synchronize absolute world coordinates.
Major world-generation formula changes require WORLD_GEN_VERSION increment.
Old saves must keep their original generator version.
Stable branches must not be overwritten.
known_items_to_verify: 0.5.11 start: a fresh Infinite World begins with exactly 300 gold and displays the custom Infinite World story instead of the original sewer introduction.
0.5.11 level gate: Hero stops at level 30 until the breakthrough succeeds; reaching 30 issues exactly one BreakthroughToken and existing level-30 saves receive one on movement.
0.5.11 trial: token enters branch 99 arena; exactly 10 enemies are spawned per wave, 10 waves total, with 30 action-value intermissions and countdown messages.
0.5.11 trial failure: lethal damage does not submit a normal game-over, consume an Ankh, or preserve trial losses; Hero/inventory/gold/energy restore and token is reissued.
0.5.11 trial success: Hero returns to the exact prior Infinite World position and unlocks level 60, equipment +120 and artifact +30 caps.
0.5.11 upgrade caps: Weapon/Armor/Ring/Wand normal upgrade() calls stop at +50 before breakthrough and +120 after; non-Infinite modes are unchanged.
0.5.11 artifact growth: pre-breakthrough +10 remains the cap; after breakthrough equipped artifacts can continue from their native cap toward visible +30 and Assist boost respects the same cap.

0.5.11 dynamic mobs: new mobs snapshot Hero level/gear/artifacts at spawn; HP answers offense, damage answers defense, accuracy/defense/type pool/EXP/loot rise moderately; already-active mobs do not rescale on equipment swap.

0.5.10 V17 artifact chest: no guaranteed artifact chest before 1000 positive Hero action-value; at/after 1000 it appears only in one valid cell of the Hero-centered 3x3 neighbourhood and grants one CrystalKey.
0.5.10 V17 solid scenery: every one of the 30 decoration kinds blocks ordinary Hero and Mob movement; none remain pass-through.
0.5.10 V17 scenery safety: all-solid placement must still preserve center crossing lanes, doors, chest vicinity, room access, merchant access and local connectivity.
0.5.10 compatibility: V16 saves retain V16 pass-through exceptions while fresh V17 worlds use all-solid scenery.
0.5.9 V16 scenery: bulky trees/barrels/crates/furniture/rails use Terrain.CUSTOM_DECO and block ordinary Hero/mob pathing while remaining non-interactive.
0.5.9 V16 scenery safety: no physical decoration may sever a one-cell corridor, block a door, occupy a chest hotspot, break merchant access, or obstruct the common center crossing lanes.
0.5.9 scenery density: ordinary chunks should visibly contain about 2-4 props and Backrooms districts about 4-13 props, with small deterministic clusters rather than isolated single sprites.
0.5.9 regional styling: industrial, office, hotel, caves, suburbs, fields, city, poolrooms and Motion districts must draw from distinct prop pools.
0.5.9 legacy V15 compatibility: old V15 worlds gain the richer visual decoration catalog/density but do not gain new solid CUSTOM_DECO blockers.
0.5.9 spectator compatibility: Infinite spectator flight ignores the new physical scenery exactly as it ignores walls.
0.5.9 magnifier: all 30 prop kinds resolve to a localized object name/description and correct Kenney sprite.
0.5.8 spectator: movement uses idle/levitating glide instead of run animation and both logical speed and PosTweener visual speed are at least x8.
0.5.8 spectator: FOV radius expands to ShadowCaster.MAX_DISTANCE=20 only while Infinite World spectator mode is active and returns to normal immediately when disabled.
0.5.8 CC0 props: bush/mushrooms/sign/barrel/crate render above existing accents without altering map collision or breaking Streaming.
0.5.8 magnifier: every new prop shows its own localized name and description instead of the underlying floor name.
0.5.8 asset pipeline: pinned Kenney atlas downloads pass Git blob verification before Gradle build.
0.5.7 V15 Backrooms archive: entering each of the 14 district types automatically unlocks exactly its matching archive page without spawning an InfiniteWorldNote.

0.5.7 V15 terrain: all 14 district layouts remain connected to shared chunk gateways and V10 infinite routes, with no isolated islands except intentionally water-surrounded visual islands that remain traversable by normal water.
0.5.7 V15 merchant density: base 3x3 lattice is already denser than V14, and newly generated chunks gain additional persisted candidate lattices as level/action tier rises.
0.5.7 V15 merchant stock: early shops contain affordable/basic goods; later shops progressively introduce wands, rings, transmutation and occasional +1 equipment.
0.5.7 V15 bag guarantee: every newly encountered merchant before collection of all four expansion bags offers one bag the Hero does not currently own; consumed shop slots must never regenerate.
0.5.7 V15 shop pricing: Infinite World Bag offers use x2 item-value pricing while ordinary shop pricing remains x5.
0.5.6 spectator: long-click/key movement can phase through WALL/WALL_DECO/solid terrain without changing Level.map and still streams at normal thresholds.
0.5.6 spectator: existing mobs remain visually present but never move, detect, attack, or interrupt Hero; InfiniteWorldMobEcology never spawns enemies while active.
0.5.6 spectator: chest opening, pickup, FOR_SALE purchase and other manual interactions still work even with frozen enemies visible.
0.5.6 spectator: Hero remains visible above walls while phasing; fog and visited cells update like normal exploration.
0.5.6 spectator: disabling inside wall/chasm safely settles Hero on nearest valid standable cell and restores normal collision/action rules.
0.5.5 V14 merchant access: every revealed merchant room must have an actually walkable route to a shared chunk gateway; no merchant landmark may be isolated behind unrelated themed-room shells.
0.5.5 legacy repair: existing V11-V13 saves must repair disconnected active merchant chunks at load/stream time and persist the terrain repair as overrides.
0.5.5 overlay refresh: bombing/changing a wall under InfiniteWorldAccentTilemap must immediately remove stale wall visuals; hero must never be visually hidden inside a logically passable old wall.
0.5.5 secret-room discovery: revealing SECRET_DOOR must rebuild room-specific accents immediately rather than waiting for the next streaming refresh.
0.5.3 V13 merchant discovery: a loaded Merchant Outpost should be revealed on the map; entering within 2 chunks should emit one localized nearby-merchant hint per outpost.
0.5.3 V13 merchant density: 4-chunk lattice plus route/anomaly exclusions should make merchants easy to encounter without making every normal chunk a shop.
0.5.3 V13 liminal density: approximately 28% of 5x5 macro-regions are anomalous and the six anomaly types should all remain traversable through V10 infinite routes.
0.5.3 V13 new anomaly notes: Yellow Maze, Service Tunnels and Dark Storage must each generate/guarantee their own collectible guide page.

0.5.2 V12 unique artifact chest: after 400 positive hero action-value, exactly one visible nearby CRYSTAL_CHEST should appear, grant a CrystalKey, contain one artifact, and never duplicate through streaming/save-load/revisits.
0.5.2 V12 artifact chest lifecycle: opening without taking the artifact must restore an ordinary heap after streaming/save-load; taking the artifact must permanently end the unique chest.
0.5.1 merchant stock: verify purchased items do not respawn after streaming or save/load.
0.5.1 merchant flee state: verify an attacked/fled merchant does not return after streaming.
0.5.1 streaming: verify shopkeeper rebases correctly and shop rooms are not cut by primary/secondary infinite routes.
0.5.1 merchant outposts: verify a fresh Generator V11 world produces shops at a discoverable but sparse cadence.
0.5.1 merchant stock: buy items, stream away/back and save/load; purchased sale heaps must not regenerate.
0.5.1 merchant streaming: shopkeeper must rebase correctly if its outpost remains in the active 7x7 window and unload without fleeing when it leaves the window.
0.5.1 merchant flee: attacking/failed theft should permanently close that outpost and remove its stock.
0.5.0 mob ecology: verify far enemies disappear without loot, XP or kill statistics.
0.5.0 mob streaming: verify nearby enemies retain correct local positions through 3-chunk window shifts and do not freeze Actor processing.
0.5.0 spawn pacing/cap: verify exploration remains dominant, usually only 1-3 enemies nearby and never more than the hard cap except transient edge cases.
0.5.0 elites: verify no more than one elite is active and elite despawn causes no environmental side effects.
0.4.4 V10 secondary infinite routes should be stress-tested over long travel in both directions and across multiple primary/secondary intersections.
0.4.3 V9 global infinite backbone should be stress-tested by travelling very far and repeatedly backtracking from dead-end side branches.
0.4.3 forced secret rooms and 55% close-range passive discovery should be verified on a fresh V9 world.
0.4.3 liminal 5x5 macro-regions should remain traversable across chunk streaming boundaries and should not regress the old water/black-map rendering fixes.
A newly discovered secret room may not receive its room-specific environment overlay until the next overlay/window rebuild.
Static room environment overlays can become visually stale after destructive terrain changes such as wall explosions; local overlay invalidation is a future improvement.

update_scope: docs/assist/BUG_HISTORY_AND_FIXES.md when bugs or failed approaches are involved
maintenance_policy.default_context_strategy: For routine local changes, inspect current code first and read only recent/directly relevant notes as needed. Do not reread the full project history by default.
full_history_review_triggers: a bug that persists after repeated fixes
monster persistence or boss persistence architecture
